summary: Protected listing and payment writes and immutable media rules passed local emulator checks. Production deployment is blocked by unverified live rules/IAM and known frontend compatibility work; this prototype is not a complete production policy.

findings.issue: Legacy username queries, product reads, address/locker writes and first-name profile uploads need explicit compatible access policies or frontend/API changes.
findings.recommendation: Complete the documented frontend compatibility work and staging journeys before integrating these rules.

findings.issue: Previously permissive rules and live storage ownership are unverified.
findings.recommendation: Verify deployed rules and IAM, set an audited media policy start time, and certify legacy photos from server-owned generation-specific provenance only.
